strapiBlog.title: UAE's most expensive penthouse sells for a whopping $136 million
strapiBlog.short_description: Setting a new standard in one of the busiest property markets, the penthouse in Como Residences was sold in Dubai for $136 million (AED 500 million).

data.text:
Setting a new standard in one of the busiest property markets, the penthouse in Como Residences was sold in Dubai for $136 million (AED 500 million). The record-breaking project has made it to the list of the most expensive penthouses in the world.

According to the Dubai Land Department (DLD) data, it is officially the city's most pricey penthouse ever built and sold — and globally the third. The document ranked Penthouse D at One Hyde Park, London ($237 million) second, while the Odeon Tower Penthouse in Monaco ($440 million) at the top. Slated to be completed in Q3 2027, the skyscraper will set the bar higher for a truly luxurious lifestyle. 

Let’s see what it will be like to live in one of the most expensive properties in the golden city!

About the Groundbreaking Deal

Sam Horani, an associate partner at Zoya Ventures Real Estate, closed the million-dollar deal for the super-luxury address. The highly anticipated under-construction project, Como Residences, will be strategically located in Palm Jumeirah, the iconic community known for its upscale residences, glamorous hotels and exclusive fine dining.

"The Como Residences Penthouse is not just a residence but a statement of ultimate luxury and exclusivity. Its sale marks a historic moment in the Dubai real estate landscape, solidifying its place as an enduring symbol of opulence for future generations," stated Sam Horani.

Inside Como Residences Penthouse

Spanned 21,949 square feet, the showstopping 5-bedroom penthouse in Como Residences will feature a 360-degree sky pool and a private elevator.

Its carefully thought-out interior design combines classic elegance with cutting-edge style. The fine quality of the design and the meticulous attention to detail demonstrate the craftsmanship.

The architectural design of Como Residences draws inspiration from the sea, featuring flowing, organic lines reminiscent of a seashell. Standing over 300 metres tall, the tower will house 81 exclusive residences, including two- to seven-bedroom apartments and a lavish duplex penthouse. 

Each floor is designed to accommodate a maximum of two apartments, ensuring privacy and exclusivity for residents. Access-controlled elevators will lead to individual private lobbies, enhancing the sense of seclusion.

data.text:
Amenities and Facilities at the Most Expensive Penthouse in Dubai

An immaculately landscaped rooftop terrace and floor-to-ceiling windows will offer views to take your breath away. Another highlight is the state-of-the-art home automation system installed in the penthouse.
Residents will enjoy an array of world-class amenities, such as a rooftop infinity pool on the 75th floor, an observation deck offering panoramic views of Dubai and the Arabian Gulf, a spa, a fully-equipped gym with panoramic views, green spaces, and children's play areas. The tower will also feature elevated private sandy beaches and a series of communal and private pools on various levels, echoing the surrounding waterfront.

What’s the Completion Date for Nakheel Como Residences?

Originally slated for completion in Q3 2027, the handover date for Como Residences has been revised to Q2 2028. This adjustment reflects the project's ambitious scope and Nakheel's dedication to delivering a development that sets a new benchmark for waterfront luxury.

faqs.question: What makes Como Residences the most expensive penthouse in Dubai?

data.answer: Como Residences holds the record for the most expensive penthouse in Dubai, sold for AED 500 million ($136 million). This ultra-luxury 5-bedroom penthouse spans nearly 22,000 sq ft and features a private elevator, a 360-degree sky pool, and panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah, setting a new global benchmark for high-end living.

faqs.question: Who is developing the Como Residences project?

data.answer: Como Residences is being developed by Nakheel, one of Dubai’s leading master developers. Known for iconic projects like the Palm Jumeirah, Nakheel brings its expertise and vision to this elite waterfront tower, redefining upscale residential living in the city.

faqs.question: Where is the Como Residences located?

data.answer: Como Residences is strategically located in the heart of Palm Jumeirah, offering residents direct access to some of the city’s most luxurious hotels, beaches, restaurants, and entertainment hubs. The location makes it a prime address for those seeking Dubai luxury penthouses with world-class surroundings.

faqs.question: What amenities are available to residents at Como Residences?

data.answer: Residents will enjoy private beach access, a rooftop infinity pool, spa and wellness facilities, panoramic gym, lush green terraces, and state-of-the-art home automation systems. These offerings are in line with what’s expected of Dubai luxury penthouses, blending elegance with innovation.

faqs.question: How tall is the Como Residences tower?

data.answer: The Como Residence tower will rise over 300 metres, making it one of the tallest residential towers in Palm Jumeirah. It will offer sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Marina from nearly every unit.

faqs.question: Who was behind the sale of the most expensive penthouse in Como Residences?

data.answer: The historic deal was closed by Sam Horani, Associate Partner at Zoya Ventures Real Estate. His successful negotiation helped cement Como Residence’s global reputation by setting a new sales record in Dubai’s luxury property market.

faqs.question: How many residences will Como Residences have?

data.answer: There will be just 76 residences across 75 storeys, ranging from two- to seven-bedroom units. Each floor will typically host only one or two residences, providing maximum privacy and exclusivity for homeowners looking to invest in Nakheel Como Residences.

faqs.question: What is the most expensive residence in Dubai?

data.answer: The most expensive residence ever sold in Dubai is a mansion on Frond N Palm Jumeirah, which was purchased for AED 600 million (approximately $163 million) in 2022 by the Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani.
